title: Stocks Pare AI-Driven Losses as Dip Buyers Emerge
summary: Wild swings lashed Wall Street again, with dip buyers fading a stock selloff that had briefly sent the Nasdaq 100 to the brink of a bear market. The tech-heavy gauge fell 1%, trimming most of plunge that was driven by worries over the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade. Eric Weiner, Bloomberg News Senior Equities Editor, says that reining in inflation and ultimately that's going to be what the fed is going to be focusing on. And the market's attention is going to increasingly turn to that. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Porky Ends Peru’s Election Year Nearly Empty-Handed
summary: Rafael López Aliaga, Lima’s brash ex-mayor, ran for office three times this year, trying to become Peru’s president, a senator and finally, the capital’s mayor once again. The right-wing businessman came close to all three and challenged electoral authorities along the way, but ended up with only a seat on the city council.

title: Mega Rail Deal Gets Unusual WH Meeting
summary: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zelenskyy Eyes New Congress If Trump Can’t Push Putin to Peace
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will reach out to the new Democrat-controlled US Congress to intensify pressure on Russia if Donald Trump fails to convince Vladimir Putin to end the war by the end of the year. Ukraine will seek a robust package of US military aid and tougher sanctions on Russia if no peace deal acceptable to Kyiv is reached, Zelenskyy said in an interview with Bloomberg late Monday.  Angela Stent, Senior Fellow at the American Enterprise Institute, says despite recent negotiations, there's no sign Russia and Ukraine are any closer to peace.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic’s Post-IPO Woes Contrast With SpaceX’s Start
summary: Anthropic PBC is experiencing a rougher initiation to public markets than SpaceX, and a host of market and technical factors threaten to weigh down its stock performance before the Claude developer reports for the first time as a public company early next year.
